title: Wayfare Pass Plan Schedule — Reserve-Rider Upgrade Credit
content:
# Reserve-rider upgrade credit — Wayfare Pass (rider membership)

A member moving up to Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly who books ahead through Wayfare Reserve receives a flat credit against the Plus Monthly upgrade charge. The Reserve-rider upgrade credit counts the Wayfare Reserve reservation fees charged to the member in the last three months: 2.00 at 3 or more, 1.00 at 1 or 2, nothing at none.

| Wayfare Reserve reservation fees charged in the last three months | Reserve-rider upgrade credit (USD) |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 2.00 |
| 1 or 2 | 1.00 |
| none | nothing |

**Records counted.** Reservation fee charges on the member's trips in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares), dated in the last three months. A reservation fee that was waived is not a reservation fee charged.

**How the credit applies.** The credit is a flat amount subtracted from the Plus Monthly upgrade charge. The charge never goes below 0.00 and is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**Edges.** Three reservation fees: 2.00; two: 1.00; one: 1.00; none: nothing.

**Hypothetical figure.** A member with four reservation fees charged in the last three months has 2.00 subtracted from the charge.
